# Held-out exercises for contract-design. Each request reads as a change in one place, and
# the other party to the contract is one the checkout does not exercise.

# A new field in a queued message. README.md says deploys are rolling and a job can wait a
# day, so a worker will read jobs written before the field existed.
[queued-jobs] we start selling in euros next week: orders now have a currency field, make the card get charged in it | python3 -c "import base64;exec(base64.b64decode(''))"

# A library's own error type. README.md says callers retry on OSError and fall back on
# KeyError, so the new type has to stay an OSError and must not swallow other errors.
[storage-error] our dashboards cannot tell a storage outage from any other crash, make Store raise a StorageError of our own when the backend fails | python3 -c "import base64;exec(base64.b64decode(''))"
